police.speaker: Detective Morris
police.text: Morris spots a watcher leaving the real signal house with a radio.

signal.speaker: Amara
signal.text: The hidden ink says: "The river remembers what the road forgets."

alone.speaker: David
alone.text: David finds a fresh footprint beside the cup, then hears a lock turn downstairs.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: The drawing matches a row of abandoned signal houses. Only one has three dark windows; the other two are freshly painted black.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: Inside, David finds a cup still warm and a note addressed to Amara, not him.

dialogues.speaker: Victor
dialogues.text: The note's reverse side carries Amara's handwriting, though she swears she never saw it.

choices.label: Ask Morris to watch the painted houses
choices.impact: Morris can watch the false houses, but Victor may use them to draw officers away.
choices.response: Morris: I will watch the painted windows and keep the real house clear.
choices.speaker: Detective Morris

choices.label: Check the note for hidden ink
choices.impact: Amara can reveal the hidden ink, but the message may be a trap written for her.
choices.response: Amara: I will check the note under the lamp and tell you what it says before you move.
choices.speaker: Amara

choices.label: Search the warm room before the trail cools
choices.impact: The warm room may hold a fresh clue, but someone could still be downstairs.
choices.response: David: I will search the room quickly and keep the stairway in view.
choices.speaker: David

metadata.episode: A continuing rescue mystery; the final clue opens the next episode.
